Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model.interfaces

Interface IGameStatus

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameStatus
public interface IGameStatus
Defines the contract for tracking the player's game status in the Sudoku application. Any class implementing this interface is responsible for managing and exposing the player's mistakes and hints used during a game session, as well as providing formatted strings for display in the user interface.

  • Method Details

    • addMistake

      void addMistake()
      Increments the mistake counter by one. Should be called each time the player places an incorrect value on the board.

    • getMistakes

      int getMistakes()
      Returns the total number of mistakes made by the player.
      Returns:
      the number of mistakes as an integer.

    • getMistakesFormatted

      String getMistakesFormatted()
      Returns a formatted string showing the total number of mistakes. Intended for display in the game's user interface.
      Returns:
      a String representing the mistake count (e.g., "Errores: 3").

    • addHelp

      void addHelp()
      Increments the hints used counter by one. Should be called each time the player requests a hint during the game.

    • getHelpsUsed

      int getHelpsUsed()
      Returns the total number of hints used by the player.
      Returns:
      the number of hints used as an integer.

    • canUseHelp

      boolean canUseHelp()
      Determines whether the player is allowed to use a hint. Implementations may use this method to enforce a hint limit. If hints are unlimited, this method should always return true.
      Returns:
      true if the player can request a hint, false if the hint limit has been reached.

    • getHelpsFormatted

      String getHelpsFormatted()
      Returns a formatted string showing the total number of hints used. Intended for display in the game's user interface.
      Returns:
      a String representing the hint count (e.g., "Pistas: 2").

    • reset

      void reset()
      Resets all game status counters back to zero. Should be called at the start of each new game session to ensure mistakes and hints are cleared from the previous game.
